rules: Rework never mutates the original activity: application inserts a new DeliveryPlanRow (activityType=REWORK) and backfills insertedRowKey.
A rework event enters the same 攒变更 lifecycle as adjustment requests: PENDING items accumulate and only enter sandbox simulation after confirmation (13 §1).
After application the dependency segment downstream of the insertion point and the critical path must be recomputed (12 §4.1).

PLAN_ROW、MILESTONE、BATCH、ROOM 或 ARRIVAL_ITEM。
按 target_type 对应对象的主键（rowKey / milestoneKey / batchKey / roomKey / arrivalItemKey）。
调整对象的业务展示名。
ADVANCE 提前 / DELAY 延后 / DEADLINE 某日期前完成。
提前/延后的天数 K，整数文本；direction=DEADLINE 时可空。
direction=DEADLINE 时的目标日 YYYY-MM-DD。
可选：PROPORTIONAL / TOPN_SLACK / SUPPLY_ADVANCE / PROPORTIONAL_EXTENSION / ADD_HEADCOUNT；空表示由引擎多策略比选。
诉求触发原因，例如客户要求提前、现场异常。

rules: requestKey = projectKey::targetType::normalized(targetKey) dedupes by target entity: resubmitting for the same entity overwrites the pending request instead of stacking (13 §1, 20 §5).
Only CONFIRMED requests enter sandbox simulation; simulation backfills scenarioKey and flips status to SIMULATED.
Impact (which rows move) is a simulation product surfaced via the scenario's options and risks, not predicted at submission time (13 §6).

新的文件哈希、Commit ID 或版本指纹。
指针更新来源系统。

rules: The action only updates pointer metadata.
Raw configuration bytes remain outside the ontology and are retrieved by storageUri plus versionHash.

AdoptDerivedRisk.description: Palantir-style local Action Type: adopt a derived risk suggestion (建议值 from the deriveContingencyRisks Function) as a persisted RiskItem, moving it out of the read-only emergent layer into the assessment's tracked risk lifecycle (then governable by UpdateRiskStatus).

displayMetadata.description: 将派生的风险建议固化为正式 RiskItem，纳入评估的风险跟踪生命周期。
采纳的派生建议 riskId；缺省时由 planId 与 riskPoint 组合生成。
所属 ContingencyPlan.planId。
所属 DeliveryProject.projectKey（取自派生建议；用于多项目隔离）。
关联 DeliverabilityAssessment.assessmentId。
风险展示名称（取派生建议的 riskName）。
生命周期风险点（EOM风险/TR5风险/EOS风险/ESS风险）。
风险类型。
风险等级（受 RiskLevel 值类型约束：高/中/低）。
风险责任人。
风险应对策略。
风险影响。
风险描述。
风险处理状态（受 RiskState 值类型约束：处理中/已关闭）。

propertyUpdates.source: 售前风险（采纳自派生建议）

rules: Adoption materializes a read-only emergent suggestion into a tracked RiskItem under the assessment.
The new RiskItem is attached to its DeliverabilityAssessment by assessmentId and to the plan by planId.
severity and state are validated against their RiskLevel / RiskState value types before persistence.

CreateContingencyPlan.description: Palantir-style local Action Type: materialize one contingency-plan generation run as a persisted ContingencyPlan header. deriveContingencyRisks output is an ephemeral suggestion; this action pins the run to a planId so downstream records (DecisionRecord / RiskItem / GapItem / RemediationTask) have a governable anchor and ApproveContingencyPlan has a target.

displayMetadata.description: 把一次预案生成固化为预案实例（DRAFT），作为决策、风险、差异、整改任务的归属锚点。
稳定预案主键（如 JD_A3_PLAN_20260610）。
所属 DeliveryProject.projectKey。
预案展示名称。
预案版本号。
客户名称。
预案对应项目名称。
生成来源说明（如 deriveContingencyRisks 派生批次、参考日期）。
发起固化的人员。
固化时间。

rules: One generation run materializes at most one ContingencyPlan per planId (re-runs upsert by primary key).
The plan starts in DRAFT and is closed out by ApproveContingencyPlan (status state machine: DRAFT/ASSESSING -> APPROVED).

CreateDeliverabilityAssessment.description: Palantir-style local Action Type: persist one deliverability assessment under a contingency plan. Bridges the generation run and decision/risk records: AdoptDerivedRisk / CreateGapItem / GenerateRemediationTask all reference assessmentId, which this action makes a real object instead of a dangling string.

displayMetadata.description: 把一次可交付性评估固化为评估实例，作为风险/差异/整改任务的 assessmentId 锚点。
稳定评估主键；缺省由 planId 与 decisionId 组合生成。
所属 DeliveryProject.projectKey。
所属 ContingencyPlan.planId。
关联 DecisionPoint.decisionId。
评估展示名称。
可交付 / 存在差异 / 不可交付（受 DeliverabilityConclusion 值类型约束）。
0-100 的可交付性评分（取派生输出）。
主要差异摘要。
评估发生时间。
评估来源说明（如派生批次）。

rules: The assessment is attached to its plan by planId and to its decision point by decisionId.
conclusion is validated against the DeliverabilityConclusion value type before persistence.

Registering an assessment advances the owning ContingencyPlan DRAFT -> ASSESSING via the follow-on lifecycle edit: the plan must already exist (CreateContingencyPlan first), and APPROVED is terminal — re-materialize the plan to start a new assessment round.

RecordContingencyDecision.description: Palantir-style local Action Type: persist one human-confirmed contingency decision as a DecisionRecord. The deriveContingencyRisks decision points (core + 4 sub-decisions, 可交付指数) are ephemeral derivations; this action pins the conclusion — confirmed as-is or overridden — into an auditable run record.

displayMetadata.description: 把派生决策点的结论经人工确认/覆盖后固化为决策记录，含决策人、意见与时点指数。
稳定决策记录主键；缺省由 planId 与 decisionId 组合生成。
所属 ContingencyPlan.planId。
所属 DeliveryProject.projectKey。
关联 DeliverabilityAssessment.assessmentId。
关联 DecisionPoint.decisionId（核心决策或子决策点）。
决策点展示名称（取派生输出）。
core（核心决策）/ sub（子决策），沿用 DecisionPoint 取值；受 DecisionLevel 值类型约束。
机器派生结论（可交付/存在风险），用于覆盖比对。
人工确认（或覆盖）后的结论；受 DecisionConclusion 值类型约束。
决策时点的可交付指数（0-100）。
决策覆盖的 riskId 清单（逗号分隔）。
做出决策确认的人员。
决策意见与依据；覆盖派生结论时必述理由。
决策确认时间。

rules: A decision record pins one decision point's conclusion for one plan; re-recording the same planId+decisionId upserts by primary key.
conclusion and derivedConclusion are validated against the DecisionConclusion value type (可交付/存在风险, aligned with the derive output).
A conclusion that differs from derivedConclusion constitutes a human override and should carry decisionComment.

DismissDerivedRisk.description: Palantir-style local Action Type: dismiss a derived risk suggestion (建议值 from the deriveContingencyRisks Function) with an auditable trace. Counterpart of AdoptDerivedRisk: the suggestion is persisted as a RiskItem in state 已驳回 so re-derives can be cross-referenced by riskId instead of resurfacing the same suggestion unanswered.

displayMetadata.description: 驳回派生的风险建议并留痕（state=已驳回），避免同一建议反复出现且无人答复。
被驳回的派生建议 riskId；缺省时由 planId 与 riskPoint 组合生成。
所属 ContingencyPlan.planId。
所属 DeliveryProject.projectKey（取自派生建议）。
关联 DeliverabilityAssessment.assessmentId。
风险展示名称（取派生建议的 riskName）。
生命周期风险点（EOM风险/TR5风险/EOS风险/ESS风险等）。
风险类型。
风险等级（受 RiskLevel 值类型约束）。
风险影响。
风险描述。
不纳入跟踪的业务理由（如误报、已由其他预案覆盖）。
执行驳回的人员。
驳回时间（落 closedAt）。

propertyUpdates.source: 售前风险（驳回派生建议）

rules: Dismissal persists the suggestion in state 已驳回 — an explicit no, not a deletion; the trace shares the RiskItem store with adopted risks and is distinguished by state.
dismissReason is recorded in sourceSummary and the dismissing user in owner; dismissedAt lands in closedAt.
Adopting the same riskId later (AdoptDerivedRisk) upserts by primary key and supersedes the dismissal.

CompleteRemediationTask.description: Palantir-style local Action Type: mark a RemediationTask as DONE with completion evidence. Closes the task half of the contingency lifecycle (GenerateRemediationTask -> ModifyInfrastructureConfig -> CompleteRemediationTask).

displayMetadata.description: 将整改任务标记为完成（DONE）并记录完成说明、完成人与完成时间。
要完成的 RemediationTask 对象。
完成情况与验证结论说明。
确认任务完成的人员。
任务完成时间。

rules: Only OPEN or IN_PROGRESS tasks can be completed; DONE and CANCELLED are terminal.
Completion records who closed the task, when, and the verification note.
